parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by the frequency of an alternating current.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem: An alternating current $I$ in a resistor of resistance $680\,\Omega$ varies with time $t$ according to $$I = 3.5\sin(40\pi t)$$ where $I$ is in $\text{A}$ and $t$ is in $\text{s}$.
parts.text: Show that the period of the alternating current is $50\,\text{ms}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
On Fig. 8.1, sketch the variation of $I$ with $t$ between $t = 0$ and $t = 100\,\text{ms}$.
{{figure:figure_8_1}}

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the root-mean-square (r.m.s.) current in the resistor.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Use data from (b), including your answer in (b)(iii), to show by calculation that the mean power in the $680\,\Omega$ resistor is half of the peak power.
